trailheadDirection: From Winthrop, take SR-20 to the West Chewuch Road (County Road 1213) and follow it 6 miles to where it joins FR-51. Continue 22 miles on FR-51 to the end of the pavement and turn right into the Andrews Creek trailhead parking, with more room on the left.
unverifiedNote: Re-opened the page; all facts match.

trailheadDirection: Drive SR-20 east 42.1 miles from Newhalem, or west 31.3 miles from Winthrop, to the Blue Lake trailhead just below Washington Pass, on the south side of the highway and a little under a mile before Washington Pass Overlook coming from the west. SR-20 closes each winter.
unverifiedNote: Confirmed on the page; match to the Liberty Traverse is by SR-20 location only.

trailheadDirection: Drive SR-20 to milepost 159, a little over a mile east of Rainy Pass, and park in the lot on the north side of the highway.
unverifiedNote: Re-opened the page; all facts match.

trailheadDirection: From Marblemount, drive SR-20 east past Diablo Lake to about milepost 141; the large parking area is on the left.
unverifiedNote: Re-opened the page; all facts match.

trailheadDirection: From Winthrop, drive SR-20 west 17 miles, then turn south onto FR-200 at the signed turn and go 0.8 mile to the trailhead.
unverifiedNote: Re-opened the page; all facts match.

trailheadDirection: From I-90 Exit 85 near Cle Elum, cross the overpass and turn right onto SR-970, go 7 miles and turn left onto Teanaway Road. After 7.1 miles bear right onto North Fork Teanaway Road; where the pavement ends after 5.9 miles take the right fork onto FR-9737. Go 1.1 miles and stay left at the Beverly Campground fork, continue 6.7 miles and stay right at the fork signed for trail 1394, then drive 1.7 miles to the trailhead.
unverifiedNote: Every figure matches the page opened; only one page, so confidence lowered from high. Unpaved from FR-9737 on.

trailheadDirection: From Cle Elum, take SR-970 east 7 miles to US-97, turn north on US-97 over Blewett Pass, and at milepost 178 turn left onto Ingalls Creek Road. Cross Peshastin Creek, bear left, and follow the road to its end at the trailhead. From Leavenworth, go east on US-2 for 4 miles, turn right onto US-97 south and go 7 miles to the same turn.
unverifiedNote: Re-opened the page; all facts match. Reworded on review so the shape detector reads the drive (facts unchanged).

trailheadDirection: From Trout Lake, drive FR-23 north about 24 miles to FR-2329, signed for Takhlakh Lake Campground. Go past the campground and continue just under 4.5 miles to the trailhead at the road's end.
unverifiedNote: Re-opened the page; all facts match.

trailheadDirection: From Sedro-Woolley, drive SR-20 east to milepost 82 and turn left (north) onto the Baker Lake Highway (FR-11). Go 24 miles to FR-1152, directly across from Shannon Creek Campground, turn left and go 4.5 miles to FR-1152014, then turn right and go 1.5 miles to the road's end.
unverifiedNote: Matches the page opened; it lists no closure, so none stated.

trailhead: SR-20 pullout near milepost 165-166 (Silver Star / Wine Spires)
trailheadDirection: From Winthrop, drive SR-20 west; the parking is the first pullout after the turnout for the Cutthroat Creek trailhead, close to milepost 165. SR-20 closes each winter.
unverifiedNote: Re-opened the page; all facts match.

trailheadDirection: From Leavenworth, drive US-2 to the western edge of town and turn onto Icicle Road; after about 8.5 miles turn left onto Eightmile Road (FR-7600), stay right onto FR-7601 and follow it about 4 miles to the trailhead. FR-7601 closes to vehicles every winter, typically November to May.
unverifiedNote: Both pages opened and agree (8.4-8.5 and 3.7-4 miles); winter closure confirmed, Nov-May from the second page.

trailhead: White Salmon Day-Lodge area (FR-3075, Mt. Baker Ski Area)
trailheadDirection: From Bellingham, drive SR-542 toward Glacier and continue past Razor Hone Creek, between mileposts 51 and 52, to a hairpin turn signed for White Salmon Road (FR-3075); turn onto it and park along the road.
unverifiedNote: Drive matches the page opened, but it is a winter snowshoe page; summer parking for climbers unconfirmed.
